locales.description: ProductTally helps creators and small teams choose SaaS and digital products through sourced product profiles and practical guides. We also help product makers explain what they have built through commissioned editorial coverage.

facts.label: Audience
facts.value: Creators, small teams and product makers

facts.label: Content
facts.value: Product profiles, practical guides and SaaS news

facts.label: Languages
facts.value: English, Spanish, Japanese and Simplified Chinese

examples.title: What to give away when you sell templates on Payhip
examples.description: Help readers finish one quote for free, then give them a paid pack to manage deposits, balances, and changes.

examples.title: How to turn a vertical CapCut edit into a horizontal video
examples.description: Keep the existing timing and replace only shots that need wider source footage or new subtitles.

examples.title: How to check NotebookLM citations against the original PDF
examples.description: Compare conflicting sources in Gemini Notebook, formerly NotebookLM. Follow citations and check dates, units and scope using two public FCC reports.

locales.description: ProductTally 通过有来源的产品介绍和实用指南，帮助创作者与小团队选择 SaaS 和数字产品；也通过受委托的专题内容，帮助产品创作者讲清产品价值与使用场景。

examples.title: 用 Payhip 卖模板，免费版该留什么？
examples.description: 用一张报价表吸引有需求的读者，再把订金、尾款和变更管理做成付费项目包。

examples.title: CapCut 竖屏转横屏：保留剪辑节奏，调整必要镜头
examples.description: 按三种易出错镜头检查素材、画面重构和字幕，保留已剪好的内容节奏。

examples.title: 如何回到 PDF 原文核对 NotebookLM 的引用？
examples.description: 用 Gemini Notebook（原 NotebookLM）对照两份 FCC 公开报告，回查引用原文、日期、单位和适用范围，解释数字为什么不同。

locales.description: ProductTally ayuda a creadores y equipos pequeños a elegir SaaS y productos digitales con perfiles documentados y guías prácticas. También presenta productos mediante contenido editorial por encargo.

examples.title: Qué regalar cuando vendes plantillas en Payhip
examples.description: Ayuda a tus lectores a cerrar un presupuesto y ofrece un pack de pago para gestionar anticipos, saldos y cambios.

examples.title: Cómo pasar un montaje de CapCut de vertical a horizontal
examples.description: Conserva la línea de tiempo y cambia solo los planos que requieren material más ancho o subtítulos nuevos.
